deltas.reason: React Aria components already own value, keyboard, pointer, drag and controlled/uncontrolled callback flow at the interaction host. m3-ui does not expose or emulate Compose SliderState callback mutation.

deltas.surface: Ripple bounded/focus configuration and inset-focus guidance
deltas.reason: Shared m3-ui Ripple already separates opacity state layers from inset focus-ring rendering and ThemeProvider owns opacity versus inset-ring policy. The upstream documentation/configuration change does not require a Kotlin-shaped configuration API on web.

The reviewed web implementation used a component-local always-on focus outline instead of the shared ThemeProvider/Ripple focus policy. This re-pin migrates ScrollField focus indication to the shared Ripple contract, while preserving a forced-colors fallback, and proves both opacity and inset-ring focus modes in Chromium.

The reviewed expressive TimePicker sequence changes uncontained side-control spacing and dial-mode geometry. m3-ui has no Compose dialog-only mode-switch surface, so it does not invent one. It adopts the observable renderer facts that map to the public web picker: a 12px vibrant vertical display-to-dial gap, zero extra vibrant vertical clock-face bottom space, and a 40px vibrant horizontal period selector. Standard geometry remains 36px gap, 24px bottom space and the existing 38px horizontal period selector. Standalone vibrant container padding remains a documented web surface adaptation.

deltas.surface: DatePicker previous/next availability on first frame
deltas.reason: m3-ui derives month navigation disabled state synchronously from the current visible month and configured year range rather than from lazy-list scroll availability.
This is an AndroidX internal text-input state/transform implementation migration. Web date input remains owned by React Aria/native field semantics; no Compose internal state object is ported.
The upstream change replaces internal BasicTextField state plumbing. m3-ui intentionally uses browser numeric text fields and React state for the same observable input contract.

deltas.surface: Experimental Compose carousel parallax modifier API
deltas.reason: m3-ui exposes web carousel geometry/state/render callbacks rather than Compose Modifier APIs. The experimental MultiAspect-to-carouselParallaxScrollEffect rename does not justify adding a Kotlin-shaped public modifier surface to the web package.

deltas.surface: Checkbox Android Auto/TV adaptive size and corner style
deltas.reason: The new 22dp/4dp style is selected by Android device categories (Auto/TV). m3-ui keeps the canonical baseline 18px checkbox and does not invent UA/device-category sniffing for web. Window/container adaptive policy remains separate from component baseline geometry.
AndroidX describes the change as an API-facade/implementation split with existing behavior retained. m3-ui does not port internal Compose style architecture.
